title: Clarify delegation MCP bridge serving-session identity
outcome: TermalDelegationMcpBridge.parent_session_id is used as the session served by the bridge, including reviewer-child endpoints, so the name is misleading and can invite future routing mistakes. Rename it to a role-neutral serving-session identifier or document the invariant at the structured review call site, with focused routing coverage retained.
